name: Storm of Spirits
text: Fight. This attack uses [willpower] instead of [combat]. If you succeed, instead of its standard damage, this attack deals 2 damage to each enemy at the attacked enemy's location (any additional damage is dealt to the attacked enemy). If a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], [elder_thing], or [auto_fail] token is revealed during this attack, deal 1 damage to each investigator at the attacked enemy's location.
text_cn: 攻击。这次攻击不使用[combat]，改为使用[willpower]。如果你成功，这次攻击不造成基础伤害，而是对被攻击敌人所在地点的每名敌人造成2点伤害(所有额外伤害只对受到攻击的敌人造成)。(FAQ, v2.0)如果这次攻击中抽出[skull]、[cultist]、[tablet]、[elder_thing]或[auto_fail]标记，对所在地点每位调查员造成1点伤害。
